instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout structures to achieve asymmetrical bento grids and overlap.
Do NOT use generic Shadcn Card components for the portfolio or services. Build custom sharp-edged divs with hover effects.

Use Shadcn Form, Input, Textarea, Select for the 'Request a Free Estimate' section, but customize them to have a 'minimalist editorial' look: remove rounded corners (use `rounded-none`), use border-b only for inputs, and remove default shadows.
All containers, buttons, and images MUST use `rounded-none` to enforce the architectural style.
The Hero section should have a warm gradient or subtle overlay (e.g. `bg-black/30`) so the white/cream serif text stands out.
Use the Tetris Grid (Mode A) for the portfolio and services sections. Emphasize asymmetry and generous spacing (`gap-8`, `gap-12`).
Admin page should be a clean, high-contrast dashboard using Shadcn Table to display submissions, sticking to the same font families.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes for testing.
Use `lucide-react` for icons with thin stroke-width (1 or 1.5) to keep the minimal look.
